routesCompared.method: Download individually licensed photographs, matte cutouts, rig 2D parts, composite with CSS 3D
routesCompared.risk: Fragmented copyright chain; mismatched lighting, pose and resolution; asset/credit dependency

routesCompared.method: Hand-author editable SVG silhouette, face, coat, paper atlas and headwear; isolate each part in spatial planes; animate joints
routesCompared.benefit: Original coherent expressive identity; no external downloads; clean copyright provenance; mobile-friendly
routesCompared.risk: Flat-looking output if there is no real Z layering or orbit

prevention: Confirm hand-authored silhouettes and expression details at face scale before environment
Separate 19 cutout planes with nonzero depth (z range -64 to 88 CSS px), not one flattened poster
Isolate reusable module and its CSS from gallery UI
Do not use WebGL or external JS/asset CDNs for a purely paper-cutout brief
Limit orbit yaw to +/-31 degrees to prevent physically thin planes from vanishing
Pointercancel, lostpointercapture, keyboard arrows, reduced-motion and tap controls before publishing
Treat browser/Android visual quality as unverified until actually opened
